meta_description: JNW Electrical Ltd is your trusted electrician in Southampton. NICEIC registered, emergency callouts available. Call 07900 395429 for a free quote today.
hero_subhead: Faulty wiring, blown fuses, or no power? JNW Electrical responds fast in Southampton — same-day repairs available.
services_subhead: From emergency repairs to full rewires, JNW Electrical handles every electrical need with care and expertise.

services.title: Emergency Electrical Repairs
services.desc: Power cuts, blown fuses, and faulty switches fixed fast. We carry stock parts and aim to restore power the same day, any time of day or night.

services.title: Domestic Rewiring
services.desc: Full or partial rewires to modern standards, with new consumer units and circuit protection. Makes your home safer and improves energy efficiency.

services.title: Boiler & Heating Electrics
services.desc: Installation and repair of electric boiler systems, immersion heaters, and heating controls. NICEIC certified for domestic heating work.

services.title: Consumer Unit Upgrades
services.desc: Outdated fuse boxes replaced with modern RCD-protected units. Increases safety and allows you to run more appliances without tripping.

services.title: Fault Finding & Testing
services.desc: Intermittent faults traced and fixed using diagnostic equipment. We'll identify the root cause and put it right first time.

services.title: Socket & Switch Installation
services.desc: New outlets, USB sockets, and smart switches fitted to your specification. Neater cables, better positioning, modern finishes.

about_pullquote: I built this business to prove electricians can be honest, prompt, and fair.
about_para_1: JNW Electrical has served Southampton and Totton for nearly two decades, handling everything from emergency callouts to complete domestic rewires. We're NICEIC registered and hold all the qualifications needed to work safely on your home's electrics. Started as a one-man operation, we've grown through word of mouth because we keep our promises.
about_para_2: Every job is treated with the same care — whether it's a single socket or a full house rewire. We explain what needs doing and why, so you're never surprised by the bill. Our repeat customer rate speaks for itself; most of our work comes from people who've trusted us once and call us again.
reviews_heading: What Southampton Homeowners Say About JNW Electrical

reviews.text: Had no power in the kitchen one evening. Called JNW and Mark was here within 45 minutes. Turned out a loose connection in the consumer unit. Fixed it on the spot, explained what went wrong, and didn't overcharge. Really impressed.
reviews.author: David T.

reviews.text: Got quotes from three electricians for a rewire. JNW was competitive but more importantly, Mark answered every question I had without making me feel stupid. Work was done on schedule, site was kept clean, and he's left me with a neat job and proper paperwork. Couldn't ask for better.
reviews.author: Christine M.

reviews.text: Emergency call-out late on a Friday. Mark still came the same evening, diagnosed a faulty RCD in minutes, and sorted it before the weekend. Charged a fair rate with no hidden costs. Will definitely call them again if needed.
reviews.author: Robert K.
